explanation: The right query divides each campaign's clicks by the clicks of all the campaigns of its own channel, which the window adds up with PARTITION BY channel_id. With nothing in OVER, the window adds up every campaign, so the shares of a channel come to less than 100. Partitioning by campaign_id divides each campaign by itself, so every share is 100, and leaving out the 100.0 gives a fraction, not a percentage.
